fix.rationale:
STRATEGY: RETIME. The path is cycle_counter(DFF @ uart_rx.v:170) -> [NOR4,NAND4,OAI22,NOR2,AOI211 = the 14-bit `cycle_counter == CYCLES_PER_BIT` / `== CYCLES_PER_BIT/2` comparators, 0.31 ns] -> [AND3,AND3,NAND3 = uart_rx_valid into the FIFO write enable, 0.31 ns] -> [XOR2,XOR2,XOR2,NOR3 = gray-pointer increment / full compare in wptr_full.v, 0.24 ns]. The head of the chain IS in my scope and is a comparator sitting directly behind a counter register, so it can be moved across that register for free.

CUT/MOVE: the two CYCLES_PER_BIT comparators were moved from the Q side of `cycle_counter` to its D side and their result is now held in a new `next_bit` flop (p_next_bit). Because `next_bit_nxt` evaluates the ORIGINAL expression on the NEXT values of cycle_counter and fsm_state, `next_bit` in cycle t carries exactly the old combinational value of cycle t - latency of every consumer (n_fsm_state, recieved_data, bit_counter, cycle_counter, uart_rx_valid, uart_rx_break) is unchanged, so no reconvergent path needed re-balancing and nothing outside the module shifts in time. The comparator is now off the cc->FIFO path, which drops ~0.31 ns from a -0.02 ns violation; the new cc->next_bit path is only the compare plus one AND/OR level.

EQUIVALENCE ARGUMENT (all-input, not typical-case): cycle_counter_next == CYCLES_PER_BIT is impossible on the reset branch (0 != CYCLES_PER_BIT) and impossible on the hold branch (when !counting, fsm_state != FSM_STOP so next_bit reduces to cycle_counter == CYCLES_PER_BIT, i.e. !next_bit forces the miscompare); on the increment branch cycle_counter+1 == CYCLES_PER_BIT <=> cycle_counter == CYCLES_PER_BIT-1, with no wrap since CYCLES_PER_BIT-1 < 2**COUNT_REG_LEN. Likewise n_fsm_state == FSM_STOP is only produced from FSM_RECV/FSM_STOP, both of which are counting states, so the second term reduces to cycle_counter == CYCLES_PER_BIT/2-1. In both terms the compared constant equals neither CYCLES_PER_BIT nor CYCLES_PER_BIT/2, so next_bit is provably low and the increment branch is guaranteed - no reachability/unreachable-state assumption is used. Base case: reset drives next_bit to 0, matching the original expression at cycle_counter==0, fsm_state==FSM_IDLE, and the synchronous reset style means both versions see the same post-edge state, so the induction holds from reset for every input sequence. Widths, unsigned semantics and truncation are untouched.

REJECTED: PIPELINE - would add a cycle to uart_rx_valid, which reconverges with the FIFO write pointer and the uart_rx_data/uart_rx_break path; re-balancing that lies in wptr_full.v/the FIFO wrapper, outside my scope, so it would change observable behaviour. RESTRUCTURE - the comparators are already minimal-depth equality trees and the deep AND3/AND3/NAND3 + XOR tail is unattributed logic in the FIFO, not something I can reshape from here. NO_FIX - not warranted, since a real latency-free fix exists in the scope I was given.
